units: <cite ref="Sotah 21a:7">Sot. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>מתיירא מן הקוצין ומן הפ׳ וכ׳</he> is afraid of the thorns, the pits and the thistles (on the road); a. e.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 4:3">Bets. IV, 3</cite> <he>נוטל ממקום הפ׳</he> he may take out the fruits where they burst through the partition.
<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 7:15">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. VII, 15</cite> <he>שולי הפ׳</he> the sides of fragments of vessels (v. <cite ref="M00918"><he>מַחַץ</he></cite>).

Y. Ter. IV, 42ᵈ bot. שאין הפ׳ והתוספת שוין for the reduction and the addition are not of like proportions, i.e. the difference between 1/40 and 1/50 is not the same as that between 1/50 and 1/60 (v. פָּחַת Pi.).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 10b:27">B. Kam. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>לפ׳ נבלה</he> for the eventual depreciation of the carcass during the time intervening between the accident and the decision of the court.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 10b:28">Ib.</cite> <he>פ׳ נבלה תנאי היא</he> there is a difference of opinion among Tannaim as regards the liability for the depreciation of the carcass. Y. ib. I, 2ᵇ bot. <he>ישלם פַּחֲתָהּ</he> he must indemnify the owner for its depreciation, i.e. he must pay the difference between the value of the living and that of the dead animal.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 7:12">Esth. R. to III, 8</cite> <he>שהן מכניסין פ׳ בממונו של עולם</he> they (through their idleness) cause a diminution of the wealth of the world; a. e.
